`sdmTMBexperiments` collects experimental helpers for fitted
[sdmTMB](https://github.com/sdmTMB/sdmTMB) models. This vignette walks through the
main functions. The model-fitting chunks are shown but not evaluated (to keep the
build fast); the data and grid chunks run.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(sdmTMBexperiments)
library(sdmTMB)
```

## Model comparison

Fit a couple of models and compare their indices, spatial predictions, and
Mohn's rho.

```{r compare-models, eval = FALSE}
mesh <- make_mesh(pcod, c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 20)
m1 <- sdmTMB(density ~ 0 + as.factor(year), data = pcod,
             time = "year", mesh = mesh, family = tweedie())
m2 <- sdmTMB(density ~ 0 + as.factor(year) + depth_scaled, data = pcod,
             time = "year", mesh = mesh, family = tweedie())
nd <- replicate_df(qcs_grid, "year", unique(pcod$year))

cmp <- compare_models(m1, m2, newdata = nd, object_crs = 32609)
plot(cmp)                    # index time series with Mohn's rho
plot(cmp, type = "spatial")  # per-cell prediction-difference maps
```

## Mesh-resolution sensitivity

```{r compare-meshes, eval = FALSE}
mc <- compare_meshes(m1, mesh_cutoffs = c(10, 30), newdata = nd,
                     object_crs = 32609, reference_name = "20 km")
plot(mc)
```

## Retrospective analysis

```{r retro, eval = FALSE}
retr <- sdmTMB_retro(m1, nd, nyears = 5)
plot(retr, index_divisor = 1e3, index_unit = "1000 t")
```

## Diagnostics and result maps

All map helpers render on a `ggOceanMaps::basemap()`.

```{r diagnostics, eval = FALSE}
plot_mesh(mesh, crs = 32609, data = pcod, value = "density")

pred <- predict(m1, newdata = nd)
plot_prediction_map(pred, crs = 32609)                 # density averaged over years
plot_random_field(pred, crs = 32609, field = "omega")  # spatial field
plot_residual_qq(m1)
plot_variance_partitioning(m1)
```

## Survey comparison and prediction grids

The bundled `sebastes` dataset (beaked redfish survey stations) demonstrates the
prediction-grid helpers. `make_survey_prediction_region()` builds a concave hull
around a survey's stations, and `make_prediction_grid()` lays a regular grid over
it.

```{r grids, message = FALSE}
data(sebastes)
eggan <- subset(sebastes, cruiseseries == "EggaN")

region <- make_survey_prediction_region(eggan, crs = 32633, concavity = 5)
grid <- make_prediction_grid(region, resolution = 20)

nrow(grid)
head(grid)
```

`compare_surveys()` ties this together: it fits a model per survey series, builds
each survey's grid, and compares the survey indices to a compiled reference
index.

```{r compare-surveys, eval = FALSE}
# With a compiled model + index for the full domain:
sc <- compare_surveys(
  data = sebastes,
  compiled_index = compiled_index,   # data.frame with year/est/lwr/upr/se
  compiled_model = compiled_model,   # a fitted sdmTMB model
  surveys = c("EcoS", "WinterS", "EggaN"),
  newdata = full_grid,
  offset_col = "swept_area"
)
plot(sc)                   # scaled index time series
plot(sc, type = "scatter") # survey vs compiled
plot(sc, type = "spatial") # prediction differences
```
